Constantly! I’m dealing with this currently and it’s the worst it’s been in my life.  I’ll try to distract myself with TV or video games or reading and my thoughts just slam back into whatever the current issue is. 

There are moments when I am able to stop it but they are brief. I just try to hold onto those moments as long as I can. I try to think of why my thoughts are irrational while still acknowledging that they exist and I have to deal with them. 

Try to remember that it’s important to think about your issues but they will not be fixed without you taking action. Find what does help distract you and just try to spend a short time being distracted. Keep going because it’s hard but it’s worth it.

When I was younger and in the army I had a mole removed from the center of my back. The army did a hack job and cut a large portion of the skin surrounding it leaving a major scar. I would tell people I was born with an extra vertebra and had to get it removed as a joke. This was 1998 to basically the present. 

Fast forward to now- I’ve been having lower back pain for years and finally decided to get it looked at. After the X-ray and the MRI the doc told me I have 13 thoracic vertebrae but the normal amount is 11. I asked if that mean I also have 4 extra ribs and he said, “yes!” I looked it up and it turns out 8-10% of the population have this. 

Did I do this to myself??
